newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsui to buy stake in Bertelsmann software unit.
newsitem.headline: Mitsui to buy stake in Bertelsmann software unit.

text.p: Japanese trading house Mitsui & Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it would invest 2.8 million German marks in a software develpment unit of media conglomerate Bertelsmann AG at the end of November.
Afterwards, Mitsubishi will hold a 35 percent stake in the unit, T1 Gesellschaft Fuer Audi-Visuelle Produktionen GmbH.
In the tie-up, Mitsubishi and Bertelsmann will jointly develop game software for personal computers and market them in Japan and Europe, a Mitsui spokesman said.
Mitsubishi also hopes to join Bertelsmann in expanding into various multimedia businesses, including broadcasting, publishing, mail-order sales, in the future, the spokesman said.
A Japanese business daily, Nihon Keizai Shimbun, reported on Tuesday that Mitsubishi and Bertelsmann plan to jointly begin a mail-order book sales business in early 1997.
The paper also said that they also plan to cooperate in a television shopping service in Europe.
